items.summary: A flaw has been found in nanocoai NanoClaw up to 2.0.64. Affected is the function handleAddMcpServer of the file src/modules/self-mod/request.ts of the component add_mcp_server. Executing a manipulation can lead to improper authorization. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. This patch is called e5b928783d5c485637565eb07d2967922dfbf8d8. A patch should be applied to remediate this issue.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-17434 影响 nanocoai NanoClaw 2.0.64 及之前版本，存在于组件 add_mcp_server 的 src/modules/self-mod/request.ts 文件中的 handleAddMcpServer 函数。该函数存在授权不当漏洞，攻击者可远程发起攻击，导致机密性、完整性和可用性部分损失。漏洞利用代码已公开，增加了被利用的风险。官方已发布补丁，commit 为 e5b928783d5c485637565eb07d2967922dfbf8d8。建议用户立即升级至修复版本或应用补丁，并限制对受影响服务的网络访问以降低风险。

items.title: The Fluent Forms Pro Add On Pack plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in all versions up to, and including, 6.2.6 via deserialization of untrusted input. T...
items.summary: The Fluent Forms Pro Add On Pack plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in all versions up to, and including, 6.2.6 via deserialization of untrusted input. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Subscriber-level access and above, to inject a PHP Object. The additional presence of a POP chain allows attackers to change user passwords and potentially take over administrator accounts. Note: This can only be exploited if user update integration is enabled and a user meta field is mapped.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞影响 WordPress 的 Fluent Forms Pro Add On Pack 插件，版本 ≤ 6.2.6。由于插件对用户提供的输入进行不安全的反序列化操作，导致存在 PHP 对象注入漏洞。攻击者需要拥有至少 Subscriber 级别的权限，并且目标站点必须启用“用户更新集成”功能，且映射了用户元字段。通过利用 POP 链，攻击者可以修改用户密码，进而劫持管理员账户。CVSS 评分为 8.8（高），攻击向量为网络，复杂度低，无用户交互，影响机密性、完整性和可用性。官方尚未发布补丁，建议用户升级到最新版本（如果可用），临时缓解措施包括禁用“用户更新集成”功能，或限制低权限用户的访问。该漏洞目前未被列入 KEV，也未有公开的在野利用报告。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许低权限用户通过对象注入结合 POP 链提升至管理员权限，可完全控制 WordPress 站点，危害极高。由于攻击条件相对容易满足（只需订阅者权限），且 PoC 可能被公开，需尽快修复。

items.summary: A vulnerability was detected in NousResearch hermes-agent 2026.6.5. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file hermes-agent/plugins/platforms/simplex/adapter.py of the component SimpleX Gateway Authorization. Applying a patch is advised to resolve this issue.

items.title: In Zephyr's userspace dynamic-objects subsystem, thread_idx_alloc() in kernel/userspace/userspace.c allocated a new thread permission index from the global _thread_idx_map[] bit...
items.summary:
In Zephyr's userspace dynamic-objects subsystem, thread_idx_alloc() in kernel/userspace/userspace.c allocated a new thread permission index from the global _thread_idx_map[] bitmap without holding lists_lock.

On SMP systems, two user-mode threads invoking the k_object_alloc(K_OBJ_THREAD) syscall concurrently can both observe the same low free bit, perform the same non-atomic RMW to clear it, and return the identical tidx.

The two newly created K_OBJ_THREAD objects are then assigned the same thread_id, so the two user threads alias a single bit position in every kernel object's perms[] bitfield: any subsequent grant of access on a kernel object to one thread is implicitly a grant to the other, defeating userspace ACL isolation. A secondary lost-update window between the unlocked &=~BIT() in alloc and the locked |= BIT() in thread_idx_free() can also leak entries from the thread-index pool.

The defect is reachable from any user-mode thread via the unrestricted __syscall k_object_alloc and is gated on CONFIG_USERSPACE, CONFIG_DYNAMIC_OBJECTS, and CONFIG_SMP. The flaw was introduced when the per-thread permission index was added in 2018 and is present in every release up to and including v4.4.0. Fixed by holding lists_lock across the bitmap RMW and the permissions clear (and inlining the obj_list traversal that previously took the lock itself).

llm_summary.summary_zh: 在 Zephyr RTOS 的用户态动态对象子系统中，`kernel/userspace/userspace.c` 文件中的 `thread_idx_alloc()` 函数在从全局位图 `_thread_idx_map[]` 分配新线程权限索引时，未持有 `lists_lock`。在 SMP 系统上，两个用户态线程同时调用 `k_object_alloc(K_OBJ_THREAD)` 系统调用时，可能观察到同一个空闲位，执行非原子的读-改-写操作清除该位，并返回相同的线程 ID (tidx)。这导致两个新创建的 `K_OBJ_THREAD` 对象被赋予相同的 `thread_id`，从而使得两个用户线程在内核对象的 `perms[]` 位域中别名化同一个位位置：后续对一个线程授予内核对象访问权限时，将隐式地授予另一个线程，从而破坏了用户态的访问控制列表 (ACL) 隔离。此外，在 `alloc` 中的无锁 `&=~BIT()` 与 `thread_idx_free()` 中的加锁 `|=BIT()` 之间存在二次丢失更新窗口，可能导致线程索引池中的条目泄漏。该漏洞可通过任何用户态线程无限制地调用 `__syscall k_object_alloc` 触发，且受 `CONFIG_USERSPACE`、`CONFIG_DYNAMIC_OBJECTS` 和 `CONFIG_SMP` 配置选项影响。该缺陷自 2018 年引入每线程权限索引时存在，影响直至 v4.4.0 的所有版本。修复方法为：在位图 RMW 操作和权限清除期间持有 `lists_lock`，并内联原本自身持有锁的对象列表遍历。建议所有使用 Zephyr RTOS 且启用用户态动态对象和 SMP 的系统尽快更新至包含修复的版本（如 v4.4.1 或更高）。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许攻击者在 SMP 系统上通过并发系统调用绕过用户态 ACL 隔离，导致权限提升或信息泄露，影响 Zephyr RTOS 多个版本，需优先修复。

items.title: OpenRemote before 1.26.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the console registration API that allows unauthenticated attackers to update existing console assets ...
items.summary: OpenRemote before 1.26.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the console registration API that allows unauthenticated attackers to update existing console assets by supplying a known asset identifier. Attackers can overwrite push notification tokens and console metadata without authentication or ownership validation, redirecting notifications or denying delivery to legitimate consoles.

llm_summary.summary_zh: OpenRemote 1.26.2之前的版本存在一个认证绕过漏洞。漏洞位于控制台注册API中，未经过身份验证的攻击者可以通过提供已知的资产标识符来更新现有的控制台资产。攻击者能够覆盖推送通知令牌和控制台元数据，从而将通知重定向到其他设备或完全阻止合法控制台接收通知。该漏洞无需任何认证或所有权验证，攻击者只需知道目标控制台的资产ID即可实施攻击。由于控制台资产通常具有可预测的ID或可以通过其他方式泄露，因此漏洞的影响范围较广。建议立即升级到OpenRemote 1.26.2或更高版本，以修复该漏洞。作为临时缓解措施，可以限制对控制台注册API的网络访问，仅允许可信IP段或内部网络访问，并启用额外的身份验证机制。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许未认证攻击者劫持或阻断推送通知，严重影响终端用户的服务可用性及消息传递的完整性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可以劫持推送通知通道，将通知发送到攻击者控制的设备，或完全阻止合法用户接收通知，可能导致业务中断或信息泄露。

items.title: SiYuan before v3.7.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the POST /mcp kernel endpoint, which is gated only by a general auth check (model.CheckAuth) with no admin...
items.summary: SiYuan before v3.7.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the POST /mcp kernel endpoint, which is gated only by a general auth check (model.CheckAuth) with no admin-role or read-only enforcement. This exposes 31 MCP tools, including a file tool with list/read/write/delete/rename/copy actions across the entire workspace. When the Publish server is enabled in anonymous mode (Conf.Publish.Enable=true and Conf.Publish.Auth.Enable=false), the Publish reverse proxy attaches an anonymous RoleReader JWT to proxied requests, allowing a remote unauthenticated attacker to reach /mcp. The attacker can read conf/conf.json to extract accessAuthCode, api.token, and cookieKey in plaintext, write arbitrary files in the workspace, and plant a plugin into data/plugins/ that executes with nodeIntegration:true and no contextIsolation on the next desktop launch, leading to administrator takeover.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-66012 是思源笔记 (SiYuan) v3.7.2 之前版本中存在的一个严重缺失授权漏洞。该漏洞位于 POST /mcp 内核端点，仅依赖通用身份验证检查 (model.CheckAuth)，未强制执行管理员角色或只读权限，导致 31 个 MCP 工具可被未授权访问，其中包括能够对整个工作区进行文件列表、读取、写入、删除、重命名、复制等操作的文件工具。当发布服务器启用匿名模式 (Conf.Publish.Enable=true, Conf.Publish.Auth.Enable=false) 时，发布反向代理会为代理请求附加一个匿名 RoleReader JWT，从而允许远程未经身份验证的攻击者访问 /mcp 端点。攻击者可借此读取 conf/conf.json 配置文件，以明文形式提取 accessAuthCode、api.token 和 cookieKey；可在工作区写入任意文件；可将恶意插件植入 data/plugins/ 目录，该插件在下次桌面启动时以 nodeIntegration:true 且无上下文隔离 (contextIsolation) 的环境执行，最终导致管理员账户被接管。CVSS 评分为 10.0 (严重)，影响范围广泛，攻击复杂度低，无需用户交互即可远程利用。建议立即将思源笔记升级至 v3.7.2 或更高版本；如无法立即升级，应禁用发布服务器的匿名模式，或将 /mcp 端点置于防火墙或访问控制列表之后，限制网络暴露。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞 CVSS 10.0，允许远程未授权攻击者完全控制工作区、窃取敏感凭据并植入恶意插件，最终导致管理员接管，威胁极高。

items.title: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-27 contains a memory leak vulnerability in the magick command-line interface when invalid options are provided. Attackers can trigger memory exhaustion ...
items.summary: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-27 contains a memory leak vulnerability in the magick command-line interface when invalid options are provided. Attackers can trigger memory exhaustion by repeatedly supplying malformed command-line arguments to consume system resources.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-66011 是 ImageMagick 7.1.2-27 之前版本中存在的一个内存泄漏漏洞。该漏洞位于 magick 命令行界面中，当用户提供无效选项时，程序未能正确释放已分配的内存，导致内存泄漏。攻击者可以通过反复提交格式错误的命令行参数，逐渐消耗系统内存，最终触发内存耗尽，造成拒绝服务 (DoS)。该漏洞的 CVSS 评分为 3.3（低危），攻击向量为本地 (AV:L)，攻击复杂度低 (AC:L)，无需特权 (PR:N)，但需要用户交互 (UI:R)，即受害者需要执行恶意构造的命令行。影响仅限于可用性 (A:L)，机密性和完整性不受影响。由于 ImageMagick 被广泛应用于图像处理脚本和环境中，此漏洞可能导致依赖该工具的服务因内存耗尽而崩溃或响应缓慢。建议用户升级至 ImageMagick 7.1.2-27 或更高版本以修复此问题。临时缓解措施包括限制对 ImageMagick 命令行的非信任输入，以及监控系统内存使用情况。目前没有证据表明该漏洞已在野外被利用。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞虽为低危，但可导致内存耗尽拒绝服务，影响依赖于 ImageMagick 的图像处理服务的可用性。由于无需权限即可触发，存在被用于本地拒绝服务攻击的风险。

The QAT driver exposes a character device (qat_adf_...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

crypto: qat - remove unused character device and IOCTLs

The QAT driver exposes a character device (qat_adf_ctl) with IOCTLs
for device configuration, start, stop, status query and enumeration.
These IOCTLs are not part of any public uAPI header and have no known
in-tree or out-of-tree users. Device lifecycle is already managed via
sysfs.

The ioctl interface also increases the attack surface and is the
subject of a number of bug reports.

Remove the character device, the IOCTL definitions, and the related
data structures (adf_dev_status_info, adf_user_cfg_key_val,
adf_user_cfg_section, adf_user_cfg_ctl_data). Drop the now-unused
adf_cfg_user.h header and strip adf_ctl_drv.c down to the minimal
module_init/module_exit hooks for workqueue, AER, and crypto/compression
algorithm registration.

Clean up leftover dead code that was only reachable from the removed
IOCTL paths: adf_cfg_del_all(), adf_devmgr_verify_id(),
adf_devmgr_get_num_dev(), adf_devmgr_get_dev_by_id(),
adf_get_vf_real_id() and the unused ADF_CFG macros.

Additionally, drop the entry associated to QAT IOCTLs in
ioctl-number.rst.

llm_summary.summary_zh: Linux内核中的QAT（QuickAssist Technology）驱动存在一个漏洞，涉及未使用的字符设备（qat_adf_ctl）及其相关的IOCTLs。该字符设备用于设备配置、启动、停止、状态查询和枚举，但这些IOCTLs不属于任何公开的uAPI头文件，且没有已知的内核内或内核外用户。设备生命周期已通过sysfs管理。IOCTL接口增加了攻击面，并已导致多个bug报告。此漏洞的修复措施是移除该字符设备、IOCTL定义及相关数据结构（如adf_dev_status_info、adf_user_cfg_key_val等），并清理仅通过这些已移除的IOCTL路径可访问的死代码（如adf_cfg_del_all()、adf_devmgr_verify_id()等）。受影响的内核版本需要应用此补丁以消除潜在的安全风险。建议所有使用Linux内核且启用QAT驱动的系统升级到包含此修复的内核版本。由于此变更减少了攻击面，虽然没有具体的CVSS评分，但应视为重要的安全改进。目前没有证据表明该漏洞已被在野利用。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 移除未使用的IOCTL接口减少了内核攻击面，防止潜在的内存损坏或权限提升漏洞。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 移除未使用的QAT字符设备及IOCTLs，降低攻击面，修复可能的缺陷。

items.why_it_matters: 移除未使用的IOCTL接口减少了内核攻击面，防止潜在的内存损坏或权限提升漏洞。

Sashiko identified a deadlock wh...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

tty: serial: samsung: Remove redundant port lock acquisition in rx helpers

Sashiko identified a deadlock when the console flow is engaged [1].

When console flow control is enabled (UPF_CONS_FLOW),
s3c24xx_serial_stop_tx() calls s3c24xx_serial_rx_enable() and
s3c24xx_serial_start_tx() calls s3c24xx_serial_rx_disable().

The serial core framework invokes the .stop_tx() and .start_tx()
callbacks with the port->lock spinlock already held. Furthermore, all
internal driver paths that invoke stop_tx (such as the DMA TX
completion handler s3c24xx_serial_tx_dma_complete() or the PIO TX IRQ
handler s3c24xx_serial_tx_irq()) also acquire port->lock prior to
calling it. (Note that s3c24xx_serial_start_tx() is only invoked by the
serial core).

However, s3c24xx_serial_rx_enable() and s3c24xx_serial_rx_disable()
unconditionally attempt to acquire port->lock again using
uart_port_lock_irqsave(). Since spinlocks are not recursive, this
causes a deadlock on the same CPU when console flow control is engaged.

Remove the redundant lock acquisition from both rx helper functions.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 在Linux内核的samsung串口驱动（drivers/tty/serial/samsung.c）中发现一个死锁漏洞。当启用控制台流控（UPF_CONS_FLOW）时，s3c24xx_serial_stop_tx()会调用s3c24xx_serial_rx_enable()，s3c24xx_serial_start_tx()会调用s3c24xx_serial_rx_disable()。然而，串口核心框架在调用.stop_tx()和.start_tx()回调时已经持有port->lock锁；同时，内部驱动路径（如DMA TX完成处理函数、PIO TX IRQ处理函数）在调用stop_tx前也已获取该锁。但s3c24xx_serial_rx_enable()和s3c24xx_serial_rx_disable()函数内部无条件尝试再次获取port->lock（通过uart_port_lock_irqsave()），由于自旋锁不可递归，导致同一CPU上发生死锁。修复方法是从这两个RX辅助函数中移除冗余的锁获取操作。该漏洞影响使用samsung串口控制台功能的Linux系统，可能导致系统挂起或无法响应。建议用户更新Linux内核至包含此补丁的版本（如主线内核或发行版提供的稳定更新）。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可导致系统死锁，影响控制台功能及系统稳定性，尤其对依赖串口控制台的嵌入式或服务器环境构成威胁。由于无需特殊触发条件即可复现，需优先修复。

items.title:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

drm/hyperv: validate VMBus packet size in receive callback

hyperv_receive_sub() reads msg->vid_hdr.type and...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

drm/hyperv: validate VMBus packet size in receive callback

hyperv_receive_sub() reads msg->vid_hdr.type and dispatches into one
of four message-type branches without knowing how many bytes the host
wrote into hv->recv_buf. The completion path then runs
memcpy(hv->init_buf, msg, VMBUS_MAX_PACKET_SIZE), so the consumer that
wakes on wait_for_completion_timeout() can read up to 16 KiB of
residue from a prior message as if it were the response payload.

Pass bytes_recvd into hyperv_receive_sub() and reject any packet that
does not cover the pipe + synthvid header. A single switch on
msg->vid_hdr.type then computes the type-specific payload size: the
three completion-driving types (SYNTHVID_VERSION_RESPONSE,
SYNTHVID_RESOLUTION_RESPONSE, SYNTHVID_VRAM_LOCATION_ACK) fall through
to a shared exit that requires that size before memcpy/complete, while
SYNTHVID_FEATURE_CHANGE validates its own payload and returns before
reading is_dirt_needed. Unknown types are dropped.

SYNTHVID_RESOLUTION_RESPONSE is variable length: the host fills
resolution_count entries, not the full SYNTHVID_MAX_RESOLUTION_COUNT
array. Validate the fixed prefix first so resolution_count can be
read, bound it against the array, then require only the count-sized
array, so the shorter responses the host actually sends are accepted.

Only run the sub-handler when vmbus_recvpacket() returned success. The
memcpy length is bytes_recvd, which is bounded by VMBUS_MAX_PACKET_SIZE
only on a successful receive; on -ENOBUFS vmbus_recvpacket() instead
reports the required length, which can exceed hv->recv_buf, so copying
bytes_recvd would read and write past the 16 KiB buffers. Gating on the
success return keeps the copy bounded. The nonzero-return path is itself
a malformed-message case and is now logged rather than silently skipped;
channel recovery is not attempted.

Rejected packets are reported via drm_err_ratelimited() rather than
silently dropped, matching the CoCo-hardened pattern in
hv_kvp_onchannelcallback().

llm_summary.summary_zh: Linux 内核 drm/hyperv 驱动中发现一个未验证 VMBus 数据包大小的漏洞。在 hyperv_receive_sub() 回调函数中，驱动程序在处理接收到的 VMBus 消息时，未先检查消息的实际长度。它直接读取消息头中的 vid_hdr.type 字段，并根据该值分发到四个消息类型处理分支。完成路径上执行了 memcpy(hv->init_buf, msg, VMBUS_MAX_PACKET_SIZE) 操作，即从主机接收缓冲区拷贝最多 16 KiB 的数据，但实际消息可能更短或更长。若接收失败（如 -ENOBUFS），vmbus_recvpacket() 报告所需长度可能超出缓冲区，导致越界读写。此外，对于 SYNTHVID_RESOLUTION_RESPONSE 类型，其有效载荷长度可变（由 resolution_count 决定），但未正确校验该计数，可能导致数组越界。攻击者（主机端）可以发送特制的 VMBus 消息，触发未初始化的返回值读取（例如从先前消息残留数据中读取），造成信息泄漏或内存损坏。修补方法：将 bytes_recvd 传入 hyperv_receive_sub()，拒绝不包含必要包头的数据包；对于可变长度消息，先验证固定前缀，再根据 resolution_count 验证数组大小；仅在 vmbus_recvpacket() 成功时处理消息，失败时通过 drm_err_ratelimited() 记录日志，避免越界拷贝。该漏洞影响使用 Hyper-V 虚拟化且加载了 hyperv_drm 模块的 Linux 系统。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可被主机侧滥用，可能导致客户机内核信息泄漏或内存越界，破坏机密性和完整性，影响云租户隔离安全。

items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ethtool: tsconfig: fix missing ethnl_ops_complete()

tsconfig_prepare_data() calls ethnl_ops_begin(), we need to call
ethnl_ops_complete() before returning the error.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-64526 是 Linux 内核中 ethtool 子系统的 tsconfig_prepare_data() 函数存在的一个缺陷。该函数在调用 ethnl_ops_begin() 获取操作锁后，若发生错误并提前返回时，未调用对应的 ethnl_ops_complete() 释放锁。这违反了锁的成对使用规范，可能导致资源泄漏或状态不一致。问题在社区补丁中得到修复，补丁在错误返回路径中增加了 ethnl_ops_complete() 调用。该漏洞会影响使用受影响内核版本的 Linux 系统。由于漏洞细节有限，目前尚无已知的利用实例或 PoC 公开。建议用户及时更新内核至包含修复的版本，以避免潜在的系统稳定性风险。对于无法立即更新的环境，可限制对 ethtool 命令的访问权限，但最有效的缓解措施仍是应用补丁。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可能导致内核资源泄漏或锁未释放，影响系统稳定性和可靠性。尽管尚无在野利用证据，但作为内核缺陷，应尽快修复。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞可能导致内核资源泄漏或锁未释放，影响系统稳定性和可靠性。尽管尚无在野利用证据，但作为内核缺陷，应尽快修复。

items.title:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

xfrm: move policy_bydst RCU sync from per-netns .exit to .pre_exit

The struct pernet_operations docstring i...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

xfrm: move policy_bydst RCU sync from per-netns .exit to .pre_exit

The struct pernet_operations docstring in include/net/net_namespace.h
explicitly warns against blocking RCU primitives in .exit handlers:

    Exit methods using blocking RCU primitives, such as
    synchronize_rcu(), should be implemented via exit_batch.
    [...]
    Please, avoid synchronize_rcu() at all, where it's possible.

    Note that a combination of pre_exit() and exit() can
    be used, since a synchronize_rcu() is guaranteed between
    the calls.

xfrm_policy_fini() violates this: it calls synchronize_rcu() before
freeing the policy_bydst hash tables (so no RCU reader is mid-
traversal at free time), but runs from xfrm_net_ops.exit -- once per
namespace -- so a cleanup_net() of N namespaces pays N full RCU
grace periods serially.

Use the documented pre_exit/exit split. Move the policy flush (and
the workqueue drains it depends on) into a new .pre_exit handler;
xfrm_policy_fini() then runs in .exit and frees the hash tables
after the synchronize_rcu_expedited() that cleanup_net() guarantees
between the two phases. Providing O(1) RCU grace periods per batch
instead of O(N).

Observed on Linux 6.18 with a workload doing unshare(CLONE_NEWNET)
at ~13/sec sustained: cleanup_net() and the netns_wq rescuer kthread
both stuck in xfrm_policy_fini()'s synchronize_rcu(), >300k struct
net accumulated in the cleanup queue, Percpu in /proc/meminfo climbed
to 130+ GB on 256-CPU hosts, and memcg OOMs followed. setup_net and
__put_net counts were balanced, ruling out a refcount leak.

llm_summary.summary_zh: Linux 内核 xfrm 子系统中存在一个性能与稳定性漏洞。问题源于 xfrm_policy_fini() 函数在命名空间退出（.exit）回调中直接调用 synchronize_rcu()，违反了内核 net_namespace 文档中关于 .exit 处理程序不应使用阻塞 RCU 原语的规定。该操作在每次命名空间销毁时都会引发一次完整的 RCU 宽限期等待，导致批量命名空间销毁（例如通过 unshare(CLONE_NEWNET)）时性能严重下降。具体而言，在 Linux 6.18 上，以约 13 次/秒的频率执行 unshare(CLONE_NEWNET) 时，cleanup_net() 和 netns_wq rescuer 内核线程均会陷入 xfrm_policy_fini() 的 synchronize_rcu()，导致超过 30 万个 net 结构体堆积在清理队列中，Percpu 内存统计攀升至 130+ GB（256 CPU 主机），最终触发 memcg OOM。通过将策略刷新和依赖的工作队列排空操作移至新增的 .pre_exit 处理程序，并利用 cleanup_net() 在 .pre_exit 与 .exit 之间自动执行的 synchronize_rcu_expedited()，可将每个批次的 RCU 宽限期数量从 O(N) 降至 O(1)，大幅缓解批量命名空间销毁时的性能和内存压力。该漏洞影响所有使用 xfrm 策略的 Linux 内核版本，建议尽快更新至包含此补丁的内核版本。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 此漏洞可导致内核在大量网络命名空间创建/销毁时出现严重的内存消耗和系统挂起，最终可能引发 OOM，影响多租户容器化环境或网络功能虚拟化场景的稳定性。修复可避免不必要的性能退化。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可通过反复创建和销毁网络命名空间（如 unshare(CLONE_NEWNET) 系统调用），消耗大量内核内存（Percpu 区域），导致系统内存耗尽（OOM）和拒绝服务。该漏洞影响所有使用 Linux 内核 xfrm 策略的版本，无需特权用户即可触发（用户态可执行 unshare 操作）。

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

drm/hyperv: validate resolution_count and fix WIN8 fallback

A SYNTHVID_RESOLUTION_RESPONSE with resolution_...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

drm/hyperv: validate resolution_count and fix WIN8 fallback

A SYNTHVID_RESOLUTION_RESPONSE with resolution_count > 64 walks past
the supported_resolution[SYNTHVID_MAX_RESOLUTION_COUNT] array in the
parse loop. Bound resolution_count against the array size, folded
into the existing zero-check.

When the WIN10 resolution probe fails, the caller in
hyperv_connect_vsp() left hv->screen_*_max / preferred_* unpopulated,
which sets mode_config.max_width / max_height to 0 and makes
drm_internal_framebuffer_create() reject every userspace framebuffer
with -EINVAL. The pre-WIN10 branch had the same gap for
preferred_width / preferred_height. Use a single post-probe fallback
guarded by screen_width_max == 0 so both paths converge on the WIN8
defaults.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞存在于Linux内核的drm/hyperv驱动中。当Hyper-V虚拟机的显示分辨率协商时，如果SYNTHVID_RESOLUTION_RESPONSE消息中的resolution_count字段大于64，解析循环会越界访问supported_resolution数组（该数组大小为SYNTHVID_MAX_RESOLUTION_COUNT，通常为64），导致内存越界读取。此外，当Windows 10分辨率探测失败时，hyperv_connect_vsp()函数未正确填充hv->screen_*_max和preferred_*字段，使得drm_mode_config中的max_width和max_height被设为0，进而导致所有用户态framebuffer创建请求被拒绝，表现为系统无法正常显示图形界面。对于Windows 8及更早版本，同样存在preferred_width/preferred_height未填充的问题。修复方式包括：1）对resolution_count进行边界检查，结合原有的零值检查；2）在分辨率探测失败后，使用统一的回退方法，当screen_width_max为0时采用Windows 8默认分辨率，从而避免图形子系统功能失效。该漏洞影响使用Hyper-V虚拟化的Linux内核系统，可能导致图形显示异常或潜在的内存信息泄露。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可能导致Hyper-V虚拟机中图形界面无法使用，影响云环境和虚拟化部署；同时数组越界可能引发信息泄露或系统崩溃，需要及时修复。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可能利用该漏洞造成拒绝服务（图形界面失效）或内存越界读取，但暂无在野利用证据。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 尽快更新Linux内核至包含该修复的版本（如主线或发行版安全更新），限制Hyper-V虚拟机的图形应用暴露在不可信网络中。

items.title:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

net/handshake: Take a long-lived file reference at submit

handshake_nl_accept_doit() needs the file pointer...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

net/handshake: Take a long-lived file reference at submit

handshake_nl_accept_doit() needs the file pointer backing
req->hr_sk->sk_socket to survive the window between
handshake_req_next() and the subsequent FD_PREPARE() and get_file().
The submit-side sock_hold() does not provide that.  sk_refcnt keeps
struct sock alive, but struct socket is owned by sock->file: when
the consumer fputs the last file reference, sock_release() tears
the socket down regardless of any sock_hold.

Add an hr_file pointer to struct handshake_req and acquire an
explicit reference on sock->file during handshake_req_submit().
handshake_complete() and handshake_req_cancel() release the
reference on the completion-bit-winning path.

The submit error path must also release the file reference, but
after rhashtable insertion a concurrent handshake_req_cancel() can
discover the request and race the error path.  Gate the error-path
cleanup -- sk_destruct restoration, fput, and request destruction
-- with test_and_set_bit(HANDSHAKE_F_REQ_COMPLETED), the same
serialization handshake_complete() and handshake_req_cancel()
already use.  When cancel has already claimed ownership, the submit
error path returns without touching the request; socket teardown
handles final destruction.

The accept-side dereferences are not yet retargeted; that change
comes in the next patch.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-64523 是 Linux 内核 net/handshake 子系统中的一个漏洞。该漏洞源于文件引用生命周期管理不当：在处理 TLS 握手请求时，`handshake_nl_accept_doit()` 函数需要访问 `req->hr_sk->sk_socket` 对应的文件指针，但此指针在 `handshake_req_submit()` 提交请求后可能被提前释放。具体来说，内核通过 `sock_hold()` 仅增加了 sock 结构的引用计数，但并未保证关联的 socket 结构（由 sock->file 所有）的存活。当使用者关闭最后一个文件描述符时，`sock_release()` 会销毁 socket，导致后续操作中访问已释放的内存，引发 use-after-free 漏洞。修复方案是在 `struct handshake_req` 中新增 `hr_file` 指针，并在 `handshake_req_submit()` 中通过 `get_file()` 显式获取文件引用，确保 socket 在整个请求处理期间保持有效。`handshake_complete()` 和 `handshake_req_cancel()` 在完成时释放该引用。此外，提交错误路径需与并发取消操作正确同步，使用 `test_and_set_bit(HANDSHAKE_F_REQ_COMPLETED)` 进行原子序列化，避免双重释放。此漏洞影响使用内核 TLS 握手功能的系统，攻击者可能通过恶意构造的请求触发崩溃或潜在权限提升。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可能导致 use-after-free，攻击者可利用其造成内核崩溃或潜在提权，影响系统稳定性和安全性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用此漏洞可能导致内核崩溃（拒绝服务）或权限提升，影响使用内核 TLS 握手功能的系统。

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

net/mlx5e: Fix eswitch mode block underflow on IPsec acquire SA

mlx5e_xfrm_add_state() handles acquire-flow...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

net/mlx5e: Fix eswitch mode block underflow on IPsec acquire SA

mlx5e_xfrm_add_state() handles acquire-flow temporary SAs by allocating
software state and skipping hardware offload setup.

That path jumps to the common success label before taking the eswitch mode
block. After tunnel-mode validation was moved earlier, the common success
label unconditionally calls mlx5_eswitch_unblock_mode(). For acquire SAs,
this decrements esw->offloads.num_block_mode without a matching increment.

Return directly after installing the acquire SA offload handle, so only the
paths that successfully called mlx5_eswitch_block_mode() call the matching
unblock.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞存在于 Linux 内核的 net/mlx5e 驱动中，涉及 IPsec 安全关联（SA）的 acquire 流程。当 mlx5e_xfrm_add_state() 处理 acquire 流临时 SA 时，它会分配软件状态并跳过硬件卸载设置，随后跳转到公共的成功标签。然而，该公共标签无条件调用 mlx5_eswitch_unblock_mode()，导致 eswitch 模式块计数器 (esw->offloads.num_block_mode) 出现递减不匹配，因为 acquire 路径从未调用过 mlx5_eswitch_block_mode()。这可能导致计数器下溢，进而引发后续资源管理错误或系统崩溃。修复方案是让 acquire SA 路径在安装 offload 句柄后直接返回，避免调用 mlx5_eswitch_unblock_mode()，从而确保只有成功调用 mlx5_eswitch_block_mode() 的路径才执行对应的 unblock 操作。该漏洞影响使用 Mellanox ConnectX 系列网卡并启用 IPsec 和 eswitch 模式的 Linux 系统。无 CVSS 评分，但可能造成内核不稳定或拒绝服务。建议用户及时更新 Linux 内核至包含此修复的版本（例如 6.x 或 5.x 的后续稳定版），并限制受影响系统的网络暴露。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 此漏洞可导致 eswitch 模式块计数器无限下溢，破坏内核锁定机制，可能引发系统崩溃或无法加载新规则，影响网络功能稳定性。

items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

pinctrl: meson: amlogic-a4: fix deadlock issue

Accessing the pinconf-pins sysfs node may deadlock.

pinconf_pins_show() holds pctldev->mutex, and the platform driver
calls pinctrl_find_gpio_range_from_pin(), which tries to acquire
the same mutex again, leading to a deadlock.

Use pinctrl_find_gpio_range_from_pin_nolock() to fix this issue.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞存在于 Linux 内核的 pinctrl 子系统中，具体影响 Amlogic A4 平台的引脚控制驱动。问题出现在访问 sysfs 下的 pinconf-pins 节点时，可能导致内核死锁。pinconf_pins_show() 函数在持有 pctldev->mutex 锁的情况下，平台驱动通过调用 pinctrl_find_gpio_range_from_pin() 尝试再次获取同一锁，形成递归加锁，从而引发死锁。修复方案是改用不获取锁的变体函数 pinctrl_find_gpio_range_from_pin_nolock() 来避免死锁。该漏洞影响使用该驱动的 Linux 内核版本，攻击者需要能够访问 sysfs 的 pinconf-pins 节点（通常需要本地访问权限），成功利用可导致系统拒绝服务。建议用户及时更新内核至包含此补丁的版本。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可能导致系统因死锁而崩溃，影响可用性。尽管需要本地访问，但对于运行 Amlogic A4 平台的内核系统需尽快修复。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 本地攻击者通过访问 sysfs 节点可触发死锁，导致系统拒绝服务。

items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

firmware: arm_ffa: Bound PARTITION_INFO_GET_REGS copies

The register-based PARTITION_INFO_GET path trusted the firmware-provided
indices when copying partition descriptors into the caller buffer.
Reject inconsistent counts or index progressions so the copy loop cannot
write past the allocated array.

(fixed cur_idx when exactly one descriptor in the first fragment)

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞存在于Linux内核的arm_ffa固件驱动中，具体位于PARTITION_INFO_GET_REGS功能的寄存器路径。在将分区描述符复制到调用者缓冲区时，驱动程序未对固件提供的索引进行充分验证，导致可能发生越界写入。攻击者通过利用固件提供的恶意索引值，可触发复制循环超出已分配数组的范围，从而造成内核内存破坏。修复补丁添加了对不一致计数和索引进度的检查，确保复制操作只能在有效边界内进行。该漏洞影响使用ARM FF-A固件接口的系统，本地攻击者可能利用该漏洞提升权限或导致系统崩溃。建议用户及时更新至包含修复的Linux内核版本。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可能导致内核内存越界写入，本地攻击者可利用其提升权限或造成系统崩溃，影响系统安全与稳定性。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞可能导致内核内存越界写入，本地攻击者可利用其提升权限或造成系统崩溃，影响系统安全与稳定性。

find_one_sb_stid() skips stids whose sc_status is non-ze...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

NFSD: Fix infinite loop in layout state revocation

find_one_sb_stid() skips stids whose sc_status is non-zero, but the
SC_TYPE_LAYOUT case in nfsd4_revoke_states() never sets sc_status
before calling nfsd4_close_layout(). The retry loop therefore finds
the same layout stid on every iteration, hanging the revoker
indefinitely.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞存在于Linux内核的NFSD（Network File System Daemon）组件中，具体涉及布局状态撤销过程的无限循环问题。函数find_one_sb_stid()会跳过sc_status非零的状态ID（stid），但在nfsd4_revoke_states()中处理SC_TYPE_LAYOUT类型时，在调用nfsd4_close_layout()之前并未设置sc_status，导致重试循环每次迭代都找到同一个布局stid，从而使撤销进程无限循环挂起。攻击者如果能够触发该撤销流程，可能导致系统长时间无响应，造成拒绝服务（DoS）。该漏洞影响使用NFSv4.2布局类型（如文件布局）的Linux内核版本。目前官方已发布补丁修复该问题，建议受影响的系统及时更新内核。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 漏洞可能导致NFSD服务无限循环，引发拒绝服务，影响系统稳定性。由于NFS服务常用于共享存储，易被攻击者利用，需尽快修复。

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

tcp: Fix out-of-bounds access for twsk in tcp_ao_established_key().

lockdep_sock_is_held() was added in tcp...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

tcp: Fix out-of-bounds access for twsk in tcp_ao_established_key().

lockdep_sock_is_held() was added in tcp_ao_established_key()
by the cited commit.

It can be called from tcp_v[46]_timewait_ack() with twsk.

Since it does not have sk->sk_lock, the lockdep annotation
results in out-of-bound access.

  $ pahole -C tcp_timewait_sock vmlinux | grep size
  	/* size: 288, cachelines: 5, members: 8 */
  $ pahole -C sock vmlinux | grep sk_lock
  	socket_lock_t              sk_lock;              /*   440   192 */

Let's not use lockdep_sock_is_held() for TCP_TIME_WAIT.

llm_summary.summary_zh: Linux 内核 TCP 协议栈中存在一个越界访问漏洞，位于 tcp_ao_established_key() 函数中。该漏洞源于 commit 引入的 lockdep_sock_is_held() 检查，该检查用于验证 sock 锁状态，但未正确处理 TCP timewait socket（twsk）。twsk 结构体较小（size 288），不包含 sk_lock 成员（sock 结构体中 sk_lock 偏移 440，大小 192），因此当 tcp_v[46]_timewait_ack() 等函数以 twsk 参数调用 tcp_ao_established_key() 时，lockdep_sock_is_held() 会访问越界内存。攻击者可能利用此漏洞触发内核崩溃或信息泄露，影响系统稳定性和安全性。修复方法是在 lockdep_sock_is_held() 调用前判断 socket 类型，对 TCP_TIME_WAIT 状态的 socket 跳过该检查。受影响的版本为包含该 commit 的 Linux 内核版本，建议用户及时升级至修复版本。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞影响 Linux 内核 TCP 认证选项（TCP-AO），可导致越界内存访问，可能造成内核崩溃或敏感信息泄露。虽暂无在野利用报告，但建议立即更新内核以降低风险。
